flow_ref: User story (not in the OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code receives the daily State Courts update. ocmsadminui only reads /v1/courtmention (no controller in any repo); CasIntegrationController (CAS-to-OCMS) is not credited.
note: Story status is blank in the data (requirement not given); traced normally. Synonyms tried: state court, adjudicat, court mention, mention_date, hearing, court_case, courtreminder; in all six repos. There is no State Courts interface (SFTP/webhook/batch) in thirdpartyapi, ocmsadminprivateapi or ocmsadminapi. The only court update path is the CAS-to-OCMS endpoint (CasIntegrationController casUpdateCourtNotices, ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController.java:101); that is a different source (CAS, not the daily State Courts file) and is not credited. court_mention_date is not in the DB per the comment at AxsNopoServiceImpl.java:797 (a comment, not proof). The staff UI calls GET /v1/courtmention (useSearch.ts:99-109) and the authorization mapping lists /v1/courtmention (api-authorization.properties:23), but no courtmention controller/entity exists in any Java repo.
recommendation: Evidence 0%. Do not claim the State Courts/court reminder feature; only the generic eNotification mechanism exists.

steps.step: The system receives the daily case adjudication file/update from State Courts
steps.detail: No State Courts interface: no SFTP/webhook/cron/controller named state court, adjudication or court file in the six repos (synonym grep plus check of thirdpartyapi and ocmsadminprivateapi). The CAS casUpdateCourtNotices path is a different source and is not credited.

steps.step: The system parses and validates each record and matches it to an OCMS notice
steps.detail: No parser/validator for adjudication records. No class for a State Courts file format.

steps.step: The system inserts the new court mention date on the notice
steps.detail: No court mention entity/column/repository on the server side. The comment at AxsNopoServiceImpl.java:797 says court_mention_date is not in the DB. The UI only reads /v1/courtmention (ocmsadminui/src/pages/NoticeSearch/hook/useSearch.ts:99-109) with no controller in the repos; that is a read, not a write.

steps.step: The system updates the notice court processing stage from the adjudication result
steps.detail: No logic changes stage from State Courts adjudication results. Court stage changes in the repo come from CAS (casUpdateCourtNotices, ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController.java:101), a different source; not credited.

steps.step: Updated court details show on the notice for the Court Processing Officer
steps.detail: The notice search UI filters by mention_date via GET /v1/courtmention (useSearch.ts:99-109), but no courtmention controller exists in any Java repo and no process fills the data from State Courts. Not credited; cannot verify from repo whether a generic CRUD serves this resource.
